**Role Purpose**

Lead the **end-to-end interior design strategy, development and delivery** for the organisation's hospitality portfolio, ensuring that projects achieve the desired brand identity, guest experience, design quality, functionality, cost and delivery timelines.

The role will provide design leadership across **hotel rooms, suites, lobbies, restaurants, bars, lounges, banquet areas, spas, recreational areas, back-of-house spaces and other hospitality environments**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Design Strategy & Creative Leadership**

* Establish and drive the interior design vision and standards across hospitality projects.
* Translate the hospitality brand positioning into compelling interior concepts.
* Lead concept development from brief through design development and execution.
* Review and approve design proposals, material palettes, mock-ups and samples.
* Ensure consistency of design language across multiple properties.
Introduce new materials, technologies, sustainability practices and hospitality design trends.

You’ll work closely with our technical team on live projects, contributing to backend development, cloud infrastructure, application deployment, server management, and production troubleshooting.

This is a highly practical internship designed for someone who wants to go beyond writing code and learn how to **build reliable backend systems, deploy applications to the cloud, and manage production infrastructure**.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using **Node.js, Express.js, Python, and REST APIs**.
* Design, implement, and maintain databases using **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and SQL**.
* Build and integrate APIs, authentication systems, background jobs, and third-party services.
* Deploy and manage applications on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, including Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, and other relevant services.
* Configure and manage Linux servers, application processes, environment variables, and server resources.
* Work with **Docker** to containerize applications and manage deployment environments.
* Assist in setting up and maintaining **CI/CD pipelines** for automated builds, testing, and deployments.
* Configure domains, DNS records, SSL certificates, reverse proxies, and web servers such as Nginx.
* Monitor application performance, logs, uptime, resource utilization, and production errors.
* Troubleshoot backend, networking, deployment, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Work with Git and GitHub for version control, branching, collaboration, and release management.
* Apply security best practices for API access, secrets management, server permissions, and cloud infrastructure.
* Assist with cloud resource optimization, backup strategies, and infrastructure cost management.
* Explore AI tools and automation to improve development, deployment, and operational workflows.
* Maintain technical documentation and collaborate with the team to deliver reliable, production-ready applications.

Who We’re Looking For

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field**.
* Good understanding of programming fundamentals and problem-solving.
* Familiarity with at least one programming language, preferably **JavaScript/Node.js or Python**.
* Basic understanding of backend development, REST APIs, databases, and authentication.
* Familiarity with Git, GitHub, and basic command-line operations.
* Basic understanding of Linux, networking, HTTP/HTTPS, and server-client architecture.
* Strong interest in **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), cloud infrastructure, backend engineering, and DevOps**.
* Willingness to learn Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, and infrastructure management.
* Ability to debug issues independently and research technical problems effectively.
* Comfortable working onsite and collaborating with a technical team.
* Prior projects, GitHub repositories, cloud deployments, or experience hosting applications are a strong advantage.
* A proactive mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.

What You’ll Get

* **Full-time, onsite** industry experience working on real-world software projects.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining backend services and APIs.
* Practical exposure to **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** and cloud infrastructure management.
* Experience deploying applications using Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Docker, and other relevant technologies.
* Exposure to Linux server administration, networking, DNS, SSL, and reverse proxy configuration.
* Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
* Understanding of application security, cloud cost optimization, backups, and infrastructure reliability.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced developers and technical leadership.
* Opportunity to work closely with the founding and technical team.
* A fast-paced environment where you’ll be encouraged to experiment, solve problems, and take ownership.
* Potential for a **full-time opportunity based on performance**.

Why Join Us?

This isn’t an internship where you’ll spend months watching tutorials or completing repetitive assignments.

You’ll work on real applications and learn what it takes to run them reliably in production. You’ll write backend code, configure cloud resources, deploy applications, investigate errors, automate workflows, and solve infrastructure challenges.

You’ll gain practical experience across the complete backend and DevOps lifecycle:

**Develop → Test → Containerize → Deploy → Monitor → Optimize**

By the end of the internship, you should have a stronger understanding of how modern applications are built, deployed, secured, and maintained using cloud infrastructure.

If you want to become a well-rounded **Backend Engineer with practical Cloud and DevOps skills, particularly on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, this internship is for you.

**Job Description**

About the Role
  
As a Senior Backend Engineer at Sage, you will be responsible for building, enhancing and maintaining a high-quality SaaS solution that exceeds customer and business partner expectations. You will proactively share your own knowledge for specific technical solutions and business processes in your area of responsibility. We are looking for someone with 7+ years of professional experience in backend engineering. Proficiency in English, written and verbal, is required.
  
We value humility and collaboration. We are looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos. We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code, including tests, documentation, and long-term code quality.
  
  
Location: Bangalore, India. This is a hybrid role, three days per week in the office.
  
  
Required Skills
  
Core languages & runtime- Strong TypeScript (strict mode) and Node.js (v24+) for production services.
- Solid computer-science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, async I/O.
  
Backend frameworks & APIs- REST API design with Fastify (or Express/NestJS/Koa with willingness to learn Fastify).
- JSON Schema contract design and validation (AJV or equivalent); OpenAPI/Swagger.
- Understanding of API versioning, idempotency, pagination, and error-handling patterns.
  
Data & persistence- Relational databases MySQL and/or PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning.
- Comfort with JSON-document modeling in a relational store and query compilation to SQL.
- SQL query builders (Knex or similar); parameterized queries and SQL-injection prevention.
- Caching with Redis.

- Designing for at-least-once delivery and eventual consistency.
  
Cloud & platform- AWS services (SQS, EFS, S3, IAM, ECR) in a production context.
- Containerization with Docker; familiarity with Kubernetes deployments.
  
Security- OAuth2 / OIDC / JWT validation (RS256, JWKS), token propagation, and multi-issuer auth.
- Secure coding against the OWASP Top 10; multi-tenant isolation and row-level security.
  
Testing & quality- Unit, integration, and contract testing (Vitest/Jest or equivalent); test-driven mindset.
- Linters/formatters (Biome, ESLint/Prettier) and CI discipline.
  
Tooling & workflow- Git and pull-request workflows; monorepo experience (Nx) a plus.

- Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): embeddings, vector stores/search, and context assembly pipelines.
  
  
Nice to Have- MongoDB-like query languages or building a query compiler/DSL.
- KEDA / autoscaling on queue depth; Istio service mesh; Argo Rollouts canary deploys.
- GitOps (ArgoCD) and schema-driven DB migrations (Atlas or Liquibase/Flyway).
- Observability stacks: New Relic APM, Sumo Logic, Prometheus, Pino logging.
- Domain knowledge in finance, ERP, FP&A, or accounting systems.
- Experience building AI/ML-powered backend features such as forecasting, anomaly detection, or natural-language querying over financial data.

- Successfully develop and maintain high-quality software (requirements, design, code, documentation, etc.)
- Work with product managers early on to shape product definition so that it can be built in flexible, extensible, and robust way
- Keep up to date with relevant technology areas and drive technical innovation.

description:
**We are WisdomAI.**

*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.

We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.

**About**
---------

In 1931, an engineering draughtsman named Harry Beck redrew the map of the London Underground. He ignored geography, distorted distance, and reduced the world's most complicated transit system to something anyone could read. Beck understood that when a system gets complex enough, accuracy isn't the same thing as truth. The designer's job is to make the complex legible — so people can decide where to go.  
  
**The role**

Bangalore is one of WisdomAI's largest and fastest-growing engineering hubs, and much of our platform is built there. We're hiring a Design Lead to be a core design partner to that team: owning major product areas, setting the craft bar on everything that ships from Bangalore, and growing into the office's design manager as the team grows.

The work spans our whole platform. Chat on Data, Live Apps, our Slack and Teams apps, MCP, our visualizations, and a major push into agents: always-on teammates for the enterprise, grounded in Wisdom's context engine. Every one of these has to feel like the same product, built by the same hands.

**Design at WisdomAI**
----------------------

**Craft is the product.** People make real decisions from what we show them. A chart that's technically correct but visually misleading is a failure. An answer that's right but illegible is a failure. Craft isn't decoration here. It's the product working.

**AI-native by default.** Exploration often starts in an LLM — clarifying intent, mapping edge cases, pressure-testing a direction before a single frame exists. We prototype in code, move fluidly between Claude, Cursor, Paper, and Figma, and aren't precious about toolchain. We optimize for velocity and quality.

**Small and senior, on purpose.** With today's AI tools, a handful of exceptional designers can have outsized impact. Everyone here owns real territory, and the team grows only when the bar stays this high. You'll work alongside a designer in Bangalore and the design team in San Mateo, directly with our VP of Design.

**What you'll work on**
-----------------------

* **Coherence across the platform.** Think in systems from the context engine outward, so a definition, an answer, a chart, or an agent behaves the same way in chat, in Slack, in a Live App, and over MCP.
* **Agents.** Define what a great enterprise agent feels like: how it takes on work, reports back, earns trust, asks before acting, and shows up where people already work.
* **Live Apps.** Customers build anything here: a daily brief that reads like the New York Times, a pricing simulator with deep sensitivity analysis, a dashboard on steroids, a mobile metric tracker. You'll design the best of them, and the templates and primitives that let everyone else build their own — for apps and for agents.
* **The context engine.** Make a deep, powerful layer of semantics, definitions, and governance legible to the people who configure it and the people who rely on it.
* **Data visualization, occasionally.** Our charts are a signature of the product. You'll pick up visualization work from time to time.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own product areas end to end, from customer discovery and problem framing with PMs and engineers through launch and iteration.
* Work side by side with engineers every day. Make design a fast, natural part of how Bangalore builds, not a handoff.
* Prototype early and often with AI tools, building working things rather than static frames, then carry validated concepts through full state coverage and system alignment.
* Set the craft bar in crits and in what ships. Share prompts, patterns, and process with the team.
* Extend our design system so new surfaces arrive coherent by default.
* Partner closely with design leadership in San Mateo across time zones, and help hire and grow the Bangalore design team.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 7+ years designing products, with a body of work in complex B2B, data, analytics, AI, or developer tools.
* A high bar for craft — visual, UI, and interaction. You notice the 1px things, and you know which ones matter.
* Impeccable taste, and opinions you can explain and defend.
* Sharp product thinking and a talent for taming complexity: you find the simple model hiding inside a sprawling system.
* A systems mind. You've driven coherence across many surfaces, not just polished a single flow.
* You work AI-natively today. You design with LLMs and AI prototyping or coding tools daily, and you can show how they've changed your work.
* You've mentored other designers and earned the trust of engineering teams, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Nice to haves**
-----------------

* You code, or consider yourself one part design engineer.
* An interest in data visualization. Experience is welcome but not required.
* You've designed agentic experiences, or templates and systems that other people build with.
* A background in data visualization or analytics.
* Experience on product teams that work across the US and India.

-

**Our CRAFT**

CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

**C — Customer trust.** Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

**A — Authenticity.** We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

**T — Transparency.** We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

-

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

About Mercari India

Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting-edge technology and knowledge.

About XB (Cross Border)

Mercari has operated localised marketplaces in Japan and the United States for years. The XB (Cross Border) team recently launched a new global app, already live in Hong Kong, Taiwan and the United States, with the ambition to expand into over 100 countries in the coming years. Behind that expansion is one engineering goal: build a global app platform that lets existing and future product services run consistently across every region, without the fragmentation that comes from excessive localisation.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast

Our organization is also shaped by our four foundations:

* Sustainability
* Diversity & Inclusion
* Trust & Openness
* Well-being for Performance

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization.

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture.

Work Responsibilities

* Shape technical direction for XB (cross-border) backend systems that let buyers in the US, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Europe buy from Japanese sellers on Mercari and Mercari Shops.
* Lead cross-team design across the cross-border buying journey: discovery and search, item detail, pricing and landed cost, checkout and payments, and post-purchase. Set clear service boundaries and API contracts, including BFF patterns for iOS, Android and Web.
* Design and build maintainable Go services, staying hands-on in the hardest parts. Use coding agents and AI-assisted review to raise both speed and quality, and set the pattern others follow.
* Build for multi-region from day one, so one global app platform serves every market consistently, without fragmenting per country.
* Own reliability for systems that span JP marketplace services, partner APIs, payments and third-party providers. Set the standards for safe rollout, observability and incident learning, increasingly using AI-assisted automation to cut toil.
* Make 2 to 4 teams materially faster by unblocking complex design problems and simplifying the platform, increasingly by applying AI across the whole development workflow.
* Partner with PdMs and engineers in India and Japan to turn ambiguous, cross-functional problems into plans teams can execute.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders, including how they work alongside AI agents in day-to-day delivery.

**Bold Challenges**

XB is turning Japan's marketplace into a global one. Every purchase crosses languages, currencies, regulations and logistics, and depends on systems owned by many teams in Japan. This role is for someone who can reason across that whole chain, make deliberate trade-offs between speed and correctness, and give teams a technical direction they can ship against while new markets keep launching.

You will thrive here if you Go Bold by challenging architectural constraints with evidence, practise All for One by building alignment across India and Japan rather than optimizing for one team, and Be a Pro by taking responsibility for the quality and operability of your decisions. The challenge is to build technical direction that other engineers can act on while remaining close enough to implementation to test assumptions and learn from production.

**AI-native approach:** you will be at the frontline of how XB engineering changes as engineers and autonomous agents share the work. That means helping define how we design, review, ship and operate software with AI, and the standards that keep quality and reliability high as velocity goes up.

 **Requirements**  
Must-have

* 10 to 12 years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated leadership of complex backend initiatives spanning multiple teams.
* Deep experience building and running distributed systems in cloud-native environments (GCP, Kubernetes).
* Strong backend skills in Go (or proven ability to be productive in Go quickly), including API design and testing.
* Proven delivery of large, customer-visible product surfaces, not only internal services.
* Strong system design, data modeling and production debugging, with experience running systems at 99.95% availability.
* Ability to influence architecture across multiple teams without formal authority.
* Hands-on experience applying AI/LLMs to improve engineering productivity, such as coding agents, AI-assisted review, testing or debugging.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining architecture decisions and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good-to-have

* Cross-border e-commerce, payments, multi-currency or multi-region systems.
* Search, personalization or data platforms (e.g., Elasticsearch, event streams, ML pipelines).
* BFF API design and familiarity with React or mobile clients.
* Integrating with third-party partners or external APIs at scale.
* Driving platformization or tech simplification.
* Experience developing AI agents, or building AI-powered developer tooling for other engineers.

Can-learn

* Cross-border specifics like duties, tax, logistics and region rules.

We are looking for a strong, hands\-on **Java Technical Lead** who combines deep engineering capability with architecture, problem solving, design leadership, team guidance, and delivery ownership. The role is expected to understand and influence the complete application stack – from browser and network protocols through Java services, databases, messaging, infrastructure, security, scalability, deployment, and production operations. This is not a coordination\-only role. The Technical Lead must remain close to the code, be capable of diagnosing difficult technical issues, review critical implementations, make sound architecture decisions, and ensure that the team produces maintainable, scalable, secure, and production\-ready software.


##### **1\. End\-to\-End Architecture \& Solution Design**


* Own the technical design of major features, modules, integrations, and services from requirements through production deployment.
* Understand the complete request flow: browser/client \-\> DNS \-\> TCP/IP \-\> SSL/TLS \-\> HTTPS \-\> WAF/load balancer/reverse proxy \-\> application/API layer \-\> Java services \-\> cache/messaging \-\> databases \-\> infrastructure.
* Select appropriate architectural patterns and technologies based on functional requirements, system constraints, operability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Design stateless/stateful services, synchronous/asynchronous interactions, clustering, horizontal/vertical scaling, caching, distributed processing, failover, and resilience mechanisms.
* Identify architecture risks, bottlenecks, capacity constraints, integration concerns, and failure modes early in the lifecycle.
##### **2\. Hands\-on Java \& JVM Engineering**


* Provide hands\-on technical leadership in modern Java development and remain capable of implementing, debugging, profiling, and reviewing complex production code.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Java language fundamentals, collections, generics, exception handling, I/O, concurrency, synchronization, thread pools, executors, CompletableFuture, and asynchronous programming patterns.
* Understand JVM behaviour including heap/non\-heap memory, garbage collection, class loading, thread dumps, heap dumps, JVM tuning, profiling, memory leaks, CPU bottlenecks, and performance diagnostics.
* Apply clean code principles, SOLID concepts, design patterns, modularity, testability, defensive programming, and appropriate abstraction.
* Perform code reviews for correctness, performance, security, maintainability, concurrency safety, error handling, observability, and alignment with architecture.
##### **3\. Spring, APIs \& Middle\-Tier Engineering**


* Strong working experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot, including dependency injection, configuration, security, validation, persistence, transactions, and application lifecycle.
* Design RESTful APIs and service contracts with appropriate versioning, validation, error models, idempotency, pagination, timeout/retry behaviour, and backward compatibility.
* Understand microservices and modular monolith trade\-offs; design service boundaries, inter\-service communication, configuration, discovery, resilience, and dependency management appropriately.
* Experience with JPA/Hibernate or equivalent ORM technologies and awareness of ORM performance problems such as N\+1 queries, lazy loading, transaction scope, and inefficient object graphs.
* Understand web/application servers, connection/thread pools, reverse proxies, request handling, serialization, session management, and middle\-tier performance behaviour.
##### **4\. Database, Cache, Search \& Messaging**


* Strong RDBMS knowledge covering MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server or equivalent technologies.
* Design schemas and data models; understand indexing, query plans, SQL optimization, transactions, isolation levels, locking, deadlocks, connection pooling, replication, partitioning, high availability, and database scalability.
* Understand when relational, document, key\-value, search, or distributed data stores are appropriate.
* Working knowledge of technologies such as Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Cassandra or equivalents.
* Design asynchronous and event\-driven flows using Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ or equivalent messaging platforms; understand delivery semantics, ordering, retries, dead\-letter handling, consumer scaling, and idempotency.
##### **5\. Web, Network \& Security Fundamentals**


* Strong understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, certificates, DNS, TCP/IP fundamentals, proxies, reverse proxies, load balancers, firewalls/WAFs, and secure service\-to\-service communication.
* Understand authentication and authorization patterns including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SSO, identity providers, RBAC, token/session lifecycle, and secrets handling.
* Apply API and application security fundamentals including input validation, secure headers, transport security, least privilege, secrets management, dependency hygiene, and common web vulnerability mitigation.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, database, network, certificate, proxy, load\-balancing, and infrastructure layers rather than viewing the Java application in isolation.
##### **6\. High\-Level \& Low\-Level Design**


* Own and prepare High\-Level Designs (HLDs) for significant product capabilities and customer\-facing solutions.
* Document architecture, components, responsibilities, integration points, deployment topology, data flows, interfaces, security considerations, technology choices, assumptions, and NFRs.
* Break HLDs into implementable components and guide engineers in preparing Low\-Level Designs (LLDs), class/component designs, sequence diagrams, API specifications, schemas, and detailed integration logic.
* Review and validate LLDs before implementation and verify that delivered code remains aligned to approved architecture and design.
* Maintain design decision records and technical documentation at a level that supports engineering, supportability, future enhancement, and knowledge transfer.
##### **7\. Non\-Functional Requirements \& Production Engineering**


* Take explicit ownership of performance, scalability, availability, reliability, resilience, security, maintainability, extensibility, observability, auditability, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, and capacity considerations.
* Translate NFRs into measurable design and engineering requirements rather than treating them as late\-stage testing concerns.
* Define appropriate timeouts, retries, circuit\-breaking, resource limits, thread/connection pools, caching, queue sizing, health checks, graceful degradation, and failure\-handling behaviour.
* Work with QA/Performance/DevOps teams to validate NFRs through performance, load, resilience, failover, security, and operational readiness testing.
* Ensure production telemetry is sufficient for diagnosis through structured logging, metrics, traces, alerts, correlation IDs, dashboards, and actionable health indicators.
##### **8\. Problem Solving, Troubleshooting \& Root\-Cause Analysis**


* Demonstrate strong analytical problem solving and the ability to break down complex issues systematically.
* Diagnose performance degradation, memory problems, CPU spikes, deadlocks, thread starvation, slow database queries, network latency, connection exhaustion, message backlogs, and integration failures.
* Use logs, metrics, thread dumps, heap dumps, profilers, query plans, traces, operating\-system indicators, and infrastructure telemetry to isolate causes.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions rather than temporary workarounds.
* Lead the engineering response for difficult production incidents and customer\-critical technical problems when required.
##### **9\. WBS, Estimation \& Delivery Planning**


* Translate requirements and designs into clear technical work packages and implementation plans.
* Prepare and/or validate Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), ensuring tasks are sufficiently decomposed for execution and tracking.
* Prepare and validate estimates for design, development, unit testing, integration, documentation, security, performance, deployment, and production\-readiness activities.

* Work closely with Project Management to track technical progress, resolve blockers, highlight delivery risks early, and maintain realistic implementation plans.

* Conduct architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and technical walkthroughs.
